definitions.explanation: The nipple of the breast, of people or animals; also the rubber teat of a baby's bottle.

examples.japanese: {乳首|ちくび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{哺乳瓶|ほにゅうびん}→哺乳瓶：20671_honyuubin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乳首|ちくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: To replace the teat of a baby bottle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乳首|ちくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くわえられず、⟦{母乳|ぼにゅう}→母乳：13237_bonyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}めない→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: The baby cannot latch on to the nipple properly and cannot drink breast milk.

notes:
The neutral, anatomical word; used in medical and childcare contexts without awkwardness. Formal medical writing also uses {乳頭|にゅうとう}.
